open_points.subject: artifact catalogue semantics
open_points.text: “a catalogue of pointers to the documents other services hold about a project” contradicts “a pointer whose document was deleted or moved stays as it is”
open_points.question: Does the catalogue contain historical assertions that may be dangling, or only pointers to documents currently held by their named owner services?
options: The catalogue may contain dangling historical pointers until explicitly withdrawn or superseded
Every catalogued pointer must still resolve to a document held by its owner service
open_points.default_guess: Treat the catalogue as historical link records that may be dangling, because the changed actor text explicitly says Registry preserves them without checking.

open_points.subject: document-existence responsibility
open_points.text: “whether a document exists is answered by its owner service”
open_points.question: What owner-service action answers existence, who may call it, what identifier it accepts, what observable answer it returns, and how unavailable, unauthorized, moved and deleted documents differ?
options: A declared owner-service existence/resolve operation with defined callers, result and failures
Dereferencing uri or payload_ref itself is the existence check
No standardized existence answer; each consumer interprets the reference under the owner service's own contract
open_points.default_guess: Leave Registry unaware and require the owner service's own contract to define a resolve or existence operation for its references.
